text.text: Grey pressure plates opens door at the end of level
Blue pressure plates opens door immediately
Watch the counter to see how many grey plates you still need to activate
*Slimes can be used to activate plates Dante can't reach
These platforms only move left & right
These platforms can sink according to dante's weight
Energy Balls restore mana and refill itself overtime
Dante can respawn at checkpoints scattered throughout the levels if he dies
